import os, json, hashlib, platform, subprocess, sys, time, tempfile, datetime, resource, functools
from pathlib import Path
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1024**3, 1024**3))
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (120, 120))
start = time.monotonic()
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
FORB = ('uu', 'ttttt', 'ututtu')
# --- Independent Boolean-cell forward (signed, Z2 boundary v_-1=v_-2=0) ---
def fwd_bool(v, g, nbits=None):
    if nbits is None:
        nbits = max(1, (v.bit_length() if v >= 0 else (v % (1 << 24)).bit_length()) + 4)
        if v < 0:
            nbits = 32
    out = 0
    veven = (v & 1) == 0
    for i in range(nbits):
        vi = (v >> i) & 1
        vim1 = ((v >> (i-1)) & 1) if i-1 >= 0 else 0
        vim2 = ((v >> (i-2)) & 1) if i-2 >= 0 else 0
        ti = vi ^ (vim1 | vim2)
        if g == 't':
            oi = ti
        elif g == 'u':
            oi = ti ^ (1 if i == 0 else 0)
        else:
            oi = ti ^ (1 if i == 0 else 0) ^ (1 if (i == 1 and veven) else 0)
        if oi:
            out |= (1 << i)
    return out
# --- Independent Boolean-cell inverse (triangular bit solver) ---
def inv_bool(x, g):
    assert isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0
    n = x.bit_length() + 10
    if n < 12:
        n = 12
    if g == 't':
        c = x
    elif g == 'u':
        c = x ^ 1
    else:
        c = x ^ 1 ^ (2 if (x & 1) else 0)
    v = 0
    for i in range(n):
        ci = (c >> i) & 1
        vim1 = ((v >> (i-1)) & 1) if i-1 >= 0 else 0
        vim2 = ((v >> (i-2)) & 1) if i-2 >= 0 else 0
        vi = ci ^ (vim1 | vim2)
        if vi:
            v |= (1 << i)
    top = v >> (n-2)
    if top == 0:
        sv = v
    elif top == 3:
        sv = v - (1 << n)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('non-integer tail')
    return sv
# packed cross-check only (not the decision path)
def G_pack(v, g):
    return (v ^ ((v << 1) | (v << 2))) ^ (0 if g == 't' else 1) ^ (2 if (g == 'p' and v % 2 == 0) else 0)
def replay(word):
    v = 0
    for g in word:
        v = fwd_bool(v, g, nbits=max(8, v.bit_length() + 5) if v >= 0 else 32)
    return v
def orbit_bool(x0):
    states = [x0]; w = ''
    x = x0
    reason = 'cap'
    for _ in range(16):
        q = {7: 'u', 11: 't'}.get(x % 16)
        if q is None:
            reason = 'undefined-gate'; break
        if any(f in (w + q) for f in FORB):
            reason = 'forbidden-factor'; break
        w += q
        x = fwd_bool(fwd_bool(x, 'p', nbits=x.bit_length()+6) >> 2, q, nbits=x.bit_length()+6)
        states.append(x)
    return {'word': w, 'states': states, 'stop': reason}
# named targets
counter_word = 'uuuuuutuuputp'
base_word = 'uuuuuutu'
assert replay(base_word) == 25715 and len(base_word) == 8
cx = replay(counter_word)
assert cx == 29203579, cx
assert len(counter_word) == 13 and cx.bit_length() == 25
csource = replay(counter_word[:-1])
assert csource == 6583240, csource
assert csource >> 8 == 25715
ob = orbit_bool(cx)
assert ob['word'] == 'tu' and ob['states'][:3] == [29203579, 116608679, 467256739] and ob['stop'] == 'undefined-gate'
# nongated corrected construction
inner = 'UUUUUTUTUUU'.lower()
ng_word = 'u' + inner + 'p'
assert ng_word == 'uuuuuututuuup' and len(ng_word) == 13, ng_word
ngx = replay(ng_word)
assert ngx == 29203507, ngx
assert ngx % 16 == 3
# packed agreement on named orbit + roots (cross-check)
for vv, g in [(0,'u'),(25715,'u'),(cx,'t')]:
    assert fwd_bool(vv, g, nbits=max(8, (vv.bit_length()+5))) == G_pack(vv, g)
# forced predecessors via Boolean inverses
def Branch(x, q):
    a = inv_bool(x, q)
    if a < 0:
        return {'a': a, 'class': 'RAT'}
    b = inv_bool(a, 'p')
    Bv = 4*b + 3
    return {'a': a, 'b': b, 'B': Bv, 'class': 'POS' if b >= 0 else 'NEG'}
bt = Branch(cx, 't'); bu = Branch(cx, 'u')
assert bt == {'a': 6583205, 'b': 1822298, 'B': 7289195, 'class': 'POS'}, bt
assert bu == {'a': 6583206, 'b': 1822305, 'B': 7289223, 'class': 'POS'}, bu
assert bt['B'] % 16 == 11 and bu['B'] % 16 == 7
assert (fwd_bool(fwd_bool(bt['B'], 'p', nbits=32) >> 2, 't', nbits=32)) == cx
assert (fwd_bool(fwd_bool(bu['B'], 'p', nbits=32) >> 2, 'u', nbits=32)) == cx
assert (bt['B'] % 4 == 3) and (bu['B'] % 4 == 3)
for q, r in (('t', bt), ('u', bu)):
    assert not any(f in (q + ob['word']) for f in FORB)
nt = Branch(ngx, 't'); nu = Branch(ngx, 'u')
assert nt['B'] == -21630965 and nt['class'] == 'NEG', nt
assert nu['B'] == -21631001 and nu['class'] == 'NEG', nu
# independent full-inverse membership (no head pruning)
visits = []
@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def member(v, k):
    if k < 1 or v <= 0 or v.bit_length() != 2*k - 1:
        return None
    if k == 1:
        return 'u' if v == 1 else None
    for g in ('t', 'u', 'p'):
        par = inv_bool(v, g)
        w = member(par, k-1)
        if w is not None:

# ordinary status of the two endpoints via their named words (sanity)
assert member(cx, 13) is not None and len(member(cx, 13)) == 13
assert member(ngx, 13) is not None
mt = member(bt['B'], 12); mu = member(bu['B'], 12)
assert mt is None and mu is None
info = member.cache_info()
# compact exact rejection data: enumerate failing leaves under each B
C4 = (200, 222); C8p = (51292, 51431, 56937, 57038); C8u = (25646, 25715, 28468, 28519)
def head8(v):
    bl = v.bit_length(); return v >> (bl - 8) if bl >= 8 else v
def head16(v):
    bl = v.bit_length(); return v >> (bl - 16) if bl >= 16 else v
cert = {}
for label, Bv in (('t', bt['B']), ('u', bu['B'])):
    parents = []
    for g in ('t', 'u', 'p'):
        par = inv_bool(Bv, g)
        ok = par > 0 and par.bit_length() == 2*11 - 1
        parents.append({'g': g, 'par': par, 'bitlen_ok': bool(ok), 'word': member(par, 11)})
    cert[label] = {'B': Bv, 'B_head8': head8(Bv), 'B_head16': head16(Bv),
        'B_head16_in_C8p': head16(Bv) in C8p, 'B_head16_in_C8u': head16(Bv) in C8u,
        'B_head8_in_C4': head8(Bv) in C4, 'parents': parents}
summary = {'counter': {'word': counter_word, 'x': cx, 'x_mod16': cx % 16, 'orbit': ob,
    'Bt': bt['B'], 'Bt_a': bt['a'], 'Bt_b': bt['b'], 'Bu': bu['B'], 'Bu_a': bu['a'], 'Bu_b': bu['b'],
    'Bt_ordinary_word': mt, 'Bu_ordinary_word': mu, 'ordinary_word_x': member(cx, 13)},
  'nongated': {'word': ng_word, 'x': ngx, 'x_mod16': ngx % 16, 'Bt': nt['B'], 'Bu': nu['B'],
    'ordinary_word_x': member(ngx, 13)},
  'membership_memo': {'hits': info.hits, 'misses': info.misses, 'currsize': info.currsize},
  'cert': cert,
  'agrees_with_lead_values': True}
record = {'experiment_id': 'problem1-gated-membership-independent-20260906',
  'timestamp_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
  'git_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True, cwd='/home/ryan/rule30-lab').strip(),
  'question': 'problem1',

    'orbit_cap': 16, 'memory_bytes_cap': 1073741824, 'cpu_seconds_cap': 120,
    'scope': 'two named targets plus root only; ancestor recursion only; no frontier census, no word search'},
  'hardware': {'machine': platform.machine(), 'cpu_count': os.cpu_count()},
  'software': {'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform()},

  'results': {'cert': cert},
  'proof_scope': 'Named-target replay plus complete ancestor recursion; existing <=8 cores used only as read-only compatibility labels, not as pruning.',
  'interpretation': 'Counter confirmed: both admissible forced predecessors positive but non-ordinary; nongated witness confirmed distinct (both B negative, no actual branch).',
  'limitations': ['k13 below decoder u,k18 threshold; not a decoder counter', 'short continuation is not a genuine three-return', 'no minimality claim', 'existing-core labels are compatibility checks only'],
  'status': 'refuted'}
import pathlib

"""Independent bounded falsification/derivation of second inverse sign criterion.
Owns ONLY /tmp/astra-second-inverse-muse.py and /tmp/astra-second-inverse-muse.json.
No repo edits. No import of immutable reference.
Implements Boolean bit transitions independently from definitions:
  T(v) = v XOR ((v<<1) OR (v<<2)), U = T XOR 1,
  P(v) = T(v) XOR 1 XOR (2 if v even else 0).
Studies B_q(x) = 4*P^{-1}(Q^{-1}(x)) + 3 for x>=0, x=3 mod 4,
with Q=T for q=t and Q=U for q=u.
"""
import hashlib, json, os, platform, sys, time, tempfile

def bit(n, i):
    if n >= 0:
        return (n >> i) & 1
    else:
        # two's complement infinite bits: Python >> is arithmetic, &1 gives correct bit
        return ((n >> i) & 1)

def tinv_next(a_prev1, a_prev0, zin):
    """One pure T-inverse bit step. State (newest first)."""
    out = zin ^ (a_prev1 | a_prev0)
    return out, (out, a_prev1)

def qinv_int(x, Q):
    """First inverse a=Q^{-1}(x) for x>=0 int. Returns (aval, final_state)."""
    assert x >= 0
    maxb = max(x.bit_length(), 2) + 6
    a_bits = []
    s = (0, 0)
    for i in range(maxb):
        xi = (x >> i) & 1 if i < 256 else 0
        if Q == 'T':
            xpi = xi
        elif Q == 'U':
            xpi = (xi ^ 1) if i == 0 else xi
        else:
            raise ValueError
        out, s = tinv_next(s[0], s[1], xpi)
        a_bits.append(out)
    assert s in ((0,0),(1,1)), s
    N = maxb
    acc = sum(b << i for i, b in enumerate(a_bits))
    if s == (0,0):
        return acc, s
    else:
        return acc - (1 << N), s

def pinv_int(aval):
    """Second inverse b=P^{-1}(a) for integer a. Returns (bval_or_None, kind, final_state).
    kind: 'INT' with bval, or 'RAT' (denominator 7, non-integer) with bval None."""
    # build ap bits on the fly for i=0..N-1; for i>=N use tail of a
    N = max(bitlen_abs(aval), 2) + 8
    # a bits
    def abit(i):
        return bit(aval, i)
    a0 = abit(0)
    b_bits = []
    s = (0, 0)
    atail = 0 if aval >= 0 else 1
    for i in range(N):
        ai = abit(i)
        if i == 0:
            api = ai ^ 1
        elif i == 1:
            api = ai ^ a0
        else:
            api = ai
        out, s = tinv_next(s[0], s[1], api)
        b_bits.append(out)
    if atail == 0:
        assert s in ((0,0),(1,1)), s
        acc = sum(b << i for i, b in enumerate(b_bits))
        if s == (0,0):
            return acc, 'INT', s
        else:
            return acc - (1 << N), 'INT', s
    else:
        # input tail is 1: must be in 3-cycle, not fixed
        # verify non-constant cycle membership
        assert s in ((0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)), s
        return None, 'RAT', s

def bitlen_abs(n):
    if n >= 0:
        return n.bit_length()
    else:
        # bits needed to represent negative tail-1 number: bitlen of ~n plus 1? use (abs) approx
        return (abs(n)).bit_length() + 1

def Bq(x, q):
    """Returns dict with class POS/NEG/RAT and values."""
    assert x >= 0 and x % 4 == 3
    Q = 'T' if q == 't' else 'U'
    a, _ = qinv_int(x, Q)
    if a < 0:
        return {'cls': 'RAT', 'B': None, 'a': a, 'b': None}
    b, kind, _ = pinv_int(a)
    assert kind == 'INT'
    B = 4 * b + 3
    if b >= 0:
        return {'cls': 'POS', 'B': B, 'a': a, 'b': b}
    else:
        return {'cls': 'NEG', 'B': B, 'a': a, 'b': b}

# ---- admission hand checks ----
_adm1 = Bq(27, 'u')
_adm2 = Bq(7, 't')
assert _adm1['cls'] == 'POS' and _adm1['B'] == 7, _adm1
assert _adm2['cls'] == 'NEG' and _adm2['B'] == -5, _adm2
# forward consistency: check F(B)==x when gate holds (B 7/11 mod16)
# F(prev) = Q(P(prev>>2)) with gate; verify on admission positives
def F_fwd(prev, q):
    Q = 'T' if q == 't' else 'U'
    assert prev % 4 == 3
    r = prev % 16
    if q == 't':
        assert r == 11, r
    else:
        assert r == 7, r
    z = prev >> 2
    # P(z): T(z) xor 1 xor (2 if z even else 0)
    Tz = z ^ ((z << 1) | (z << 2))
    Pz = Tz ^ 1 ^ (2 if (z % 2 == 0) else 0)
    TP = Pz ^ ((Pz << 1) | (Pz << 2))
    if Q == 'T':
        return TP
    else:
        return TP ^ 1
# verify admission roundtrip for B_u(27)=7: F(7) with u? 7%16==7 yes
assert F_fwd(7, 'u') == 27, F_fwd(7, 'u')
print("admission OK:", _adm1, _adm2)

# ================= full composed-transducer analysis =================
# Pure composed step for bits i>=2 (corrections absent above bit1).
# State encoding: s = (a1<<3)|(a0<<2)|(b1<<1)|b0 with (a1,a0)=(a_{i-1},a_{i-2}), etc.
def pure_step(state, xin):
    a1 = (state >> 3) & 1; a0 = (state >> 2) & 1
    b1 = (state >> 1) & 1; b0 = state & 1
    ai = xin ^ (a1 | a0)
    bi = ai ^ (b1 | b0)
    return ((ai << 3) | (a1 << 2) | (bi << 1) | b1), ai, bi

def transfer_head(H, hlen, s_in):
    cur = s_in
    for i in range(hlen):
        cur, _, _ = pure_step(cur, (H >> i) & 1)
    return cur

def classify_outgoing(s_out, nzero=12):
    cur = s_out
    for _ in range(nzero):
        cur, _, _ = pure_step(cur, 0)
    a1 = (cur >> 3) & 1; a0 = (cur >> 2) & 1
    b1 = (cur >> 1) & 1; b0 = cur & 1
    if (a1, a0) == (1, 1):
        return 'RAT'
    assert (a1, a0) in ((0, 0),), (hex(cur))
    return 'POS' if (b1, b0) == (0, 0) else 'NEG'

def S2_state(Q):
    # bits 0,1 with x0=x1=1 (x=3 mod 4), full corrections
    a_m1 = a_m2 = b_m1 = b_m2 = 0
    x0 = 1
    xp0 = x0 if Q == 'T' else (x0 ^ 1)
    a0, _ = tinv_next(a_m1, a_m2, xp0)[0], None
    a0 = xp0 ^ (a_m1 | a_m2)
    ap0 = a0 ^ 1
    b0 = ap0 ^ (b_m1 | b_m2)
    x1 = 1; xp1 = x1
    a1 = xp1 ^ (a0 | a_m1)
    ap1 = a1 ^ a0
    b1 = ap1 ^ (b0 | b_m1)
    return (a1 << 3) | (a0 << 2) | (b1 << 1) | b0

def reachable_set(Q):
    s2 = S2_state(Q)
    reach = {s2}; stack = [s2]
    while stack:
        cur = stack.pop()
        for xin in (0, 1):
            nxt, _, _ = pure_step(cur, xin)
            if nxt not in reach:
                reach.add(nxt); stack.append(nxt)
    return s2, reach


def lead_checks():
    """Verify lead S2 derivation and b-window realizability claim."""
    # Hand S2 (newest,older) per bit-level rules with x0=x1=1:
    # t: a=(0,1) b=(1,0) S2=6; u: a=(1,0) b=(0,1) S2=9.
    t_got = S2_state('T'); u_got = S2_state('U')
    lead_t, lead_u = 4, 9  # lead claimed (0,1;0,0)=4 and (1,0;0,1)=9
    # b-window attainability at L=6 over v%4==3
    bwin = {}
    for Q in ('T', 'U'):
        w = set()
        for v in range(1 << 6):
            if v % 4 != 3:
                continue
            s = incoming_of_v(v, 6, 't' if Q == 'T' else 'u')
            # recover b bits by re-simulation to get window (b5..b2)
            sa1 = sa0 = sb1 = sb0 = 0; a0val = None; bb = []
            for i in range(6):
                xi = (v >> i) & 1
                if i == 0:
                    xpi = xi if Q == 'T' else (xi ^ 1); ai = xpi ^ (sa1 | sa0); a0val = ai; api = ai ^ 1; bi = api ^ (sb1 | sb0)
                elif i == 1:
                    ai = xi ^ (sa1 | sa0); api = ai ^ a0val; bi = api ^ (sb1 | sb0)
                else:
                    ai = xi ^ (sa1 | sa0); bi = ai ^ (sb1 | sb0)
                bb.append(bi); sa0, sa1 = sa1, ai; sb0, sb1 = sb1, bi
            w.add((bb[5], bb[4], bb[3], bb[2]))
        bwin[Q] = sorted(w)
    return {'S2_T_got': t_got, 'S2_U_got': u_got, 'lead_T_claim': lead_t, 'lead_U_claim': lead_u,
            'T_match': t_got == lead_t, 'U_match': u_got == lead_u,
            'bwin_T_n': len(bwin['T']), 'bwin_U_n': len(bwin['U']),
            'bwin_T': bwin['T'], 'bwin_U': bwin['U']}

def run_all():
    t0 = time.time()
    Cp = [51292, 51431, 56937, 57038]
    Cu = [25646, 25715, 28468, 28519]
    H8 = Cp + Cu
    BYTES = [200, 222]
    heads = [(H, H.bit_length(), ('Cp' if H in Cp else 'Cu')) for H in H8]
    heads += [(b, 8, 'byte') for b in BYTES]
    tables = {}
    for H, hlen, fam in heads:
        row = {}
        for s in range(16):
            sout = transfer_head(H, hlen, s)
            row[str(s)] = {'out': sout, 'cls': classify_outgoing(sout)}
        tables[str(H)] = {'hlen': hlen, 'family': fam, 'row': row}
    reach = {}
    for Q in ('T', 'U'):
        s2, rs = reachable_set(Q)
        reach[Q] = {'s2': s2, 'set': sorted(rs)}
    # witness search equal-l, l=2..10, per head per q (full integer Bq)
    witnesses = {}
    crosscheck_ok = True
    for H, hlen, fam in heads:
        for q in ('t', 'u'):
            key = f"{H}:{q}"
            found = None
            for l in range(2, 11):
                pos = neg = None
                for v in range(1 << l):
                    if v % 4 != 3:
                        continue
                    x = (H << l) | v
                    r = Bq(x, q)
                    # cross-check transfer classification
                    # incoming state: simulate low l bits from initial with full corrections
                    s_inc = incoming_of_v(v, l, q)
                    pred = classify_outgoing(transfer_head(H, hlen, s_inc))
                    if pred != r['cls']:
                        crosscheck_ok = False
                        raise AssertionError((H, q, l, v, pred, r))
                    if r['cls'] == 'POS' and pos is None:
                        pos = {'v': v, 'x': x, 'B': r['B'], 'a': r['a'], 'b': r['b']}
                    elif r['cls'] == 'NEG' and neg is None:
                        neg = {'v': v, 'x': x, 'B': r['B'], 'a': r['a'], 'b': r['b']}
                    if pos and neg:
                        break
                if pos and neg:
                    found = {'l': l, 'pos': pos, 'neg': neg}
                    break
            witnesses[key] = found  # None means no POS/NEG split to l=10
    dt = time.time() - t0
    return tables, reach, witnesses, dt, crosscheck_ok

def incoming_of_v(v, l, q):
    Q = 'T' if q == 't' else 'U'
    # full combined simulation bit0..l-1 from zero state
    a_m1 = a_m2 = b_m1 = b_m2 = 0
    # aval bits needed for ap1 correction: need a0 first
    a_bits = {}
    b_m1c = b_m2c = 0
    # we simulate sequentially keeping (a1,a0,b1,b0) as pure state after bit>=2, but bits0,1 with corrections
    # straightforward: loop i=0..l-1
    sa1 = sa0 = sb1 = sb0 = 0  # states a_{i-1},a_{i-2},b_{i-1},b_{i-2}; for i=0 these are 0
    a0val = None
    for i in range(l):
        xi = (v >> i) & 1
        if i == 0:
            xpi = xi if Q == 'T' else (xi ^ 1)
            ai = xpi ^ (sa1 | sa0)
            a0val = ai
            api = ai ^ 1
            bi = api ^ (sb1 | sb0)
        elif i == 1:
            xpi = xi
            ai = xpi ^ (sa1 | sa0)
            api = ai ^ a0val
            bi = api ^ (sb1 | sb0)
        else:
            ai = xi ^ (sa1 | sa0)
            bi = ai ^ (sb1 | sb0)
        sa0, sa1 = sa1, ai
        sb0, sb1 = sb1, bi
    # incoming state to head = (sa1,sa0,sb1,sb0)
    return (sa1 << 3) | (sa0 << 2) | (sb1 << 1) | sb0
